def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None):
    return CartPosition.objects.create(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_membership_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_membership_not_required(event, customer, membership, granting_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, granting_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'does not require a membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(other, [cp], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_no_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'has been canceled' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_testmode_mismatch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    membership.testmode = True
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=False)
    assert 'can not use a test mode membership' in excinfo.value.message

    membership.testmode = False
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=True)
    assert 'need to add a test mode membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    requiring_ticket.require_membership_types.clear()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'not allowed for the product' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_expired(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    assert 'is valid from' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_valid_from_not_chosen_only_checks_expiry(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start = datetime(2021, 4, 28, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=False)
    with freeze_time("2021-04-10T11:00:00+02:00"):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)
    with freeze_time("2021-05-10T11:00:00+02:00"):
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_same_time_conflict(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'at the same time' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_parallel_usage_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_max_usages_in_cart(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'more than 1 times' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_max_usages_by_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    q = event.quotas.create(size=None, name="foo")
    q.items.add(requiring_ticket)
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    order = _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=[cp1],
                          now_dt=now(),
                          sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                          payment_requests=[{
                              "id": "test0",
                              "provider": "banktransfer",
                              "max_value": None,
                              "min_value": None,
                              "multi_use_supported": False,
                              "info_data": {},
                              "pprov": BankTransfer(event),
                              "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                          }],
                          locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event)
    assert 'more than 1 times' in excinfo.value.message

    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_in_order_lock(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with transaction.atomic():
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True)
